title: Zara Zebra Zig Zag Stripes | Manipuri Kids Song, Rhymes, Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A cheerful Manipuri rhyme about a zebra and her zig zag stripes, full of fun sounds and a happy tune.
Little ones will giggle and clap along to the catchy chorus that they can sing again and again.
Sing it together and enjoy learning about colours, stripes and playful friendship!

Zig zag, zig zag, one by one
Zara's stripes go zig zag, one!
Lukluk lukluk, lukluk lukluk
Who will come to play with me today!

Nuchid scale am fangkhre, tap tap
Tamon lamel am khutsinkhre, lamel, lamel
Achum, achum, achum... aibo, one!
Ha ha ha, kari-gi nungaitab mitayengno!

Zig zag, zig zag, one by one
Zara's stripes go zig zag, one!
Lukluk lukluk, lukluk lukluk
Who will come to play with me today!

Zara nintin khondun, "Aigi lukluk nungai!"
Zebra khudingmakhal khetnai, one
Hip hap, hip hap, aman amuk
Fangkhom makhal khetnai, aigumon!

Zig zag, zig zag, one by one
Zara's stripes go zig zag, one!
Lukluk lukluk, lukluk lukluk
Who will come to play with me today!

Iman khallei, "Lamel matam, laklu, laklu!"
Lairik angoubda pen pen pen
Zig zag, zig zag, mai hainlairi
Fangkhom naitan chauthokhre, yai!
